title: Markus importer: `papyrus content import-markus` (Git Markus -> Items, media, aliases; idempotent)
description:
## Goal
`papyrus content import-markus`: load a directory of Markus files (front matter + body + images) into the CMS as `Item` + `MediaAsset` rows (and S3 objects), preserving directives, `[@key]` citations, `::image{}` markup, front matter, URLs and aliases. Idempotent and re-runnable. This is the machinery Phase 3 uses to move Pilobol.us and Anth.us from Git into the CMS (this ticket does not run it against production). Verification of "no change in output" is the round trip in `PPY-1d0f3d`.

## Context (verified)
- Source format = what `markus_renderer.build.build_markus_site(content_dir=...)` consumes (`src/papyrus_content/markus_renderer/build.py`): `articles/*.md` (required dir), optional extra section dirs (`sections=(...)`), `assets/` copied verbatim to the output, file stem -> slug via `build.slugify(stem)` (ASCII-fold, lowercase, hyphen runs; names starting `_` or `.` are not pages; two files with one slug fail). Pilobol.us (`AnthusAI/Pilobol.us`, `web/content/`): `index.md`, `a-fungus-among-us.md`, `articles/*.md` (10 files, one is `articles/index.md` = archive page), `drafts/*.md` (3 unpublished), `effects/*.md`, `assets/` (images under `assets/<slug>/...` plus reader-owned JS/CSS/HTML such as `background-manager.js`, `image-effects-lab.html`). Front matter keys seen: `title, author, date ('Sunday, September 6, 2026'), description, standfirst, cover, card_image`. Body uses `[text](url)`, `::video{src=...}`, `:::pull-quote{...}`.
- Anth.us content is MDX in `AnthusAI/anthus-site-content` (branch `content/markus-native-markup`: `posts/ solutions/ platform/ images/ diagrams/ redirects/`); `Anth.us-Papyrus/web/anthus_mdx.normalize_body` converts it to Markus Markdown at build time into `web/staging`. Phase 3 imports that normalized staging directory with this command; this ticket does not parse MDX.
- Papyrus markup: `::image{src=... alt=... layout=... caption=... credit=...}`, `[@key]`, `::citations{format="apa"}`, front-matter `citations:` CSL-JSON (`docs/markus-content-markup.md`). `content_markup.split_front_matter(text) -> (yaml_chunk, body)` (`yaml_chunk` = `text[3:end]`, no closing fence, includes the leading newline). Image src is resolved relative to the pipeline `source_dir` (default the content dir): `images.ImagePipeline.resolved_source_dir(content_dir)`.
- `Item.type` is also used for non-CMS rows (`doctrine` in `amplify/seed/seed.ts` L857); CMS content uses `article` and `page`.
- Building blocks from other tickets: `PPY-e169c5` `derive_body`, `PPY-b3a10e` `save_item`, `publish_item`, `item_id_for`, `FakeAuthoringClient`; `PPY-44a0f9` fields. Anthus aliases (Anth.us 403 redirect rules, generated by `web/anthus_urls.py` into `web/custom-rules.json`) must be representable: this ticket accepts them as input, Phase 3 generates the file.
- Storage: `amplify/storage/resource.ts` `media/*` is guest-readable and editor/admin-writable; bucket name via `env.storage_bucket_from_amplify_outputs()`.

## Exact changes
1. `src/papyrus_content/markus_import.py` (new):
   ```python
   @dataclass
   class ImportOptions:
       content_dir: Path
       article_dirs: tuple[str, ...] = ("articles",)    # items here get type "article"; every other dir/root file -> "page"
       draft_dirs: dict[str, str] = {}                   # {"drafts": "articles"}: files in drafts/ become DRAFT items in section "articles"
       aliases_file: Path | None = None                  # JSON {"<section>/<slug>" or "<slug>": ["/old/path", ...]}
       publish: bool = True
       force: bool = False
   class MediaStore(Protocol):
       def put(self, storage_path: str, local_path: Path, *, content_type: str, sha256: str) -> str: ...   # "uploaded" | "unchanged"
       def get(self, storage_path: str, dest: Path) -> None: ...
   class S3MediaStore(MediaStore): ...    # boto3, bucket from --bucket or amplify_outputs.json; head_object Metadata["sha256"] decides unchanged; lazy import with a clear error if boto3 missing ("install papyrus-newsroom[newsroom]")
   class DirMediaStore(MediaStore): ...   # directory-backed, for tests and the round-trip check
   def discover(options) -> list[SourceFile]
   def plan_import(options, client, store) -> ImportPlan
   def run_import(plan, client, store, *, apply: bool) -> ImportReport
   ```
   Discovery: walk `content_dir`; skip names starting `_` or `.`, and the directories `assets`, `node_modules`, `.git`, anything in `draft_dirs` is mapped as described; `section` = POSIX relative directory (`None` for root files); `slug = slugify(stem)` (import from `markus_renderer.build`); id = `item_id_for(section, slug)`; collisions (same section+slug) abort; `type` per `article_dirs`; `status` = `draft` for `draft_dirs` files else `published`.
   Per file: `front_matter_yaml, body_markus = split_front_matter(text)` stored VERBATIM (the yaml chunk without its leading newline is what `compose_source` re-wraps); `metadata.source = {"path": "<relpath>.md" (the original relative path, with the original stem), "importedContentHash": <hash>}`; aliases = front-matter `aliases:` list + `aliases_file` entries; each alias must start with `/`, no duplicates, and must not equal any item's canonical path (`/{section}/{slug}.html`, `/{slug}.html` for root; mirrors Anth.us `_assert_no_shadowed_pages`).
   Media: scan front matter yaml + body for relative paths ending `.png .jpg .jpeg .gif .webp .avif .svg` (regex over `src="..."`, `](...)`, `cover:`-style YAML values; skip `http(s)://`, `data:`); keep those that exist under `content_dir` (resolved relative to `content_dir`, the same rule as the image pipeline); every other file under `assets/` (JS, CSS, HTML, fonts) is reader-owned and NOT imported (report the count). Each (item, path) -> `MediaAsset` `{id: "media-<itemId>-<sha256(path)[:10]>", itemId, type:"image", role: "cover" if referenced from front matter else "body", sortKey: f"{n:03d}#{path}", storagePath: f"media/{path}", alt: <basename>, width/height via Pillow when importable, metadata: to_aws_json({"srcPath": path, "sha256": ..., "bytes": ..., "contentType": ...})}`; one S3 object per distinct path (shared images upload once).
   Pipeline: (1) validate EVERYTHING first (every file derives OK via `derive_body`, slug/alias/path collisions, referenced image files exist) and abort with a full error list before any write; (2) `plan`: for each item compare the would-be `contentHash` with the existing Item: unchanged -> skip; existing edited in the CMS (`existing.contentHash != existing.metadata.source.importedContentHash`) -> skip and report `edited-in-cms` unless `--force`; (3) apply: upload media, upsert `MediaAsset` rows, `save_item(...)` (status draft first), then `publish_item` when the desired status is published and (changed or not yet published). Re-import never unpublishes and never deletes: items present in the CMS but absent from the source are only counted (`notInSource`).
2. `src/papyrus_content/markus_import_commands.py` + CLI wiring in `cli.py` (`PORTED_COMMANDS`, `dispatch`, `print_usage`): `papyrus content import-markus --content-dir DIR [--article-dirs articles,posts] [--draft-dirs drafts=articles] [--aliases-file FILE] [--bucket B] [--no-publish] [--force] [--dry-run] [--json]` (`--dry-run` = plan only; default writes, per `options.resolve_mutation_apply`). Exit 1 on any validation error. JSON report: `{"ok", "created", "updated", "unchanged", "skippedEditedInCms", "published", "mediaUploaded", "mediaUnchanged", "readerOwnedAssets", "notInSource", "errors": []}`.
3. Fixtures `procedures/newsroom/tests/fixtures/markus-content/`: `articles/hello.md` (front matter with `title/author/date/description/cover`, a link, `:::pull-quote{attribution="X"}`, `::image{src="assets/hello/a.png" alt="A" layout="full" caption="C"}`, two `[@a]` references and `::citations{format="apa"}` with `citations:` CSL-JSON in front matter, `aliases: [/blog/hello-old]`), `articles/Call Criteria.md` (slug `call-criteria`), `articles/index.md` (archive page), `index.md` (root), `drafts/wip.md`, `assets/hello/a.png` (a real 40x30 PNG), `assets/site.js` (reader-owned).

## Data shapes
Item written for `articles/hello.md` (see `PPY-b3a10e` for the full record): `id item-articles-hello`, `type article`, `section articles`, `slug hello`, `status published` after publish, `bodyMarkus` = text after the closing fence verbatim, `metadata = {"frontMatterYaml": "title: ...[LF]author: ...", "source": {"path": "articles/hello.md", "importedContentHash": "sha256:..."}}`, `aliases ["/blog/hello-old"]`. MediaAsset: `{"id": "media-item-articles-hello-3f9a1c0b27", "role": "body", "storagePath": "media/assets/hello/a.png", "metadata": "{\"srcPath\":\"assets/hello/a.png\",\"sha256\":\"...\",\"bytes\":812,\"contentType\":\"image/png\"}"}`.

## Tests
- Unit: `procedures/newsroom/tests/test_markus_import.py` (unittest, `FakeAuthoringClient` + `DirMediaStore`): the fixture imports to the expected counts (created 4 items + 1 draft; media 1 uploaded; `readerOwnedAssets 1`); re-run -> all `unchanged`, zero client writes and zero uploads; edit the source body -> `updated` and republished with `versionNumber 2`; edit the Item in the fake CMS then re-import -> `skippedEditedInCms`, with `--force` -> overwritten; `Call Criteria.md` -> `call-criteria`; slug collision (`A b.md` + `a-b.md`) -> abort naming both, no writes; alias equal to an existing canonical path -> abort; reference to a missing image file -> abort; a file with an unknown directive -> abort listing the file and error code; draft dir item is `draft` with no PublishedItem; `--no-publish` leaves everything draft.
- Gherkin: `features_backend/markus-import.feature` + `features_backend/steps/markus_import_steps.py`: "Importing a content directory creates items and media", "Importing twice changes nothing", "A CMS edit is not overwritten by a re-import", "One bad file aborts the whole import".
- Real content (no AWS writes): `gh repo clone AnthusAI/Pilobol.us /tmp/pilobol-src`, then `poetry run papyrus content import-markus --content-dir /tmp/pilobol-src/web/content --draft-dirs drafts=articles --dry-run --json` (needs a JWT only for the existing-record lookups; use a sandbox, `AGENTS.local.md`) reports 13+ items, 0 errors, and lists the reader-owned assets; record the numbers in the ticket.

## Acceptance checks
- `poetry run python -m unittest procedures.newsroom.tests.test_markus_import -v` passes; `poetry run behave features_backend/markus-import.feature` passes.
- In a sandbox: import the Pilobol.us content (non-dry-run), then `poetry run papyrus content list articles` lists the 10 articles; a second run reports `created 0 updated 0`.
- The `PPY-1d0f3d` round-trip check (`scripts/verify-markus-roundtrip.sh`) passes on the same content (that is the "output unchanged" proof).

## Dependencies
Blocked by `PPY-e169c5`, `PPY-b3a10e`, `PPY-44a0f9` (deployed to the sandbox for the real run). Blocks `PPY-1d0f3d`'s round-trip verification (EXP can be coded in parallel against `FakeAuthoringClient`) and Phase 3 (PPY-3367d3). Same-file conflicts: `cli.py` (several tickets).

## Risks
- Drafts re-section mapping (`drafts=articles`) is a convention decision; an item that is a draft in `drafts/` has `metadata.source.path = "drafts/wip.md"` but exports to `articles/wip.md` once published (the exporter uses `section/slug`, see `PPY-1d0f3d`: `source.path` is only used while the item's section matches its first path segment).
- Date strings that cannot be parsed leave `publishedAt` null; ordering then falls back to the reader. Keep the raw string in front matter (it is preserved verbatim).
- Image discovery by regex can miss paths built dynamically (none seen in Pilobol.us); the publish gate (`image-missing`, `PPY-b3a10e`) catches a miss for `::image{}`.
- Anth.us Phase 3 will need the MDX normalizer output as input; large (232 images, 197 citations): run the dry run first and keep the 300 KB `bodyIr` limit in mind (`PPY-e169c5`).

## Needs Ryan
Nothing for this ticket. (Phase 3 will need him for the production run.)

## Common rules (apply to every Phase 2 ticket)
- Work from a clean worktree of `origin/develop` (`git -C /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus fetch origin && git worktree add ../Papyrus-worktrees/<this-ticket> -b feature/PPY-22a3b4-<slug> origin/develop`). Never commit to `develop` or `main`; open a PR into `develop`; never merge to `main`. Conventional-commit messages. Update this ticket with branch, PR link and the verification output.
- `AGENTS.md` rules that bind this work: no backward-compatibility shims or fallbacks (clean breaks); backend tooling in Python unless noted; Pretext owns text measurement (do not measure DOM in React); read `AGENTS.local.md` before ANY AWS/Amplify/sandbox command; never run `ampx pipeline-deploy` locally (sandbox only).
- Note on language direction: Ryan's 2026-10-05 correction (epic comment 4174c5) says Papyrus is being ported from Python to TypeScript. Phase 2 follows the approved design in docs/standard-site.md (Python CLI/Lambdas + `papyrus-newsroom`). Keep new Python logic in small pure functions with fixture-driven tests so it can be ported; do not add new Python dependencies beyond those named here.
- Tests: Python unit tests are `unittest` under `procedures/newsroom/tests/` (run: `poetry run python -m unittest procedures.newsroom.tests.<module> -v`); backend Gherkin is `behave` under `features_backend/` with steps in `features_backend/steps/` (run: `poetry run behave features_backend/<file>.feature`); UI Gherkin is cucumber-js + Playwright under `features/` (run against a dev server: `npm run dev` then `PAPYRUS_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3001 npx cucumber-js features/<file>.feature`); TypeScript unit tests are `scripts/test-*.ts` run with `npx tsx` (add an npm script `test:<name>` in package.json).
- Install: `poetry install --extras "newsroom markus"` and `npm ci`. Verify `markus --version` prints 0.5.1 (PyPI `anthus-markus` 0.5.1 emits IR `schema_version: 1`).

- Notation: `[LF]` in this ticket text means a newline character (the board tool cannot store a backslash followed by n).
